title: Kufe me aik hashr bapa wa musibata
body:
KUFE MEIN AIK HASHR BAPA WAMUSIBATA
HYDER NE AAJ KI HAI QAZA WAMUSIBATA
Syed ko rozedaar ko maahe siyaam mein
Ghar me khuda ke qatl kiya wamusibata
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar shaq hai khoo’n se saara musalla hai tarbatar
Sajde se sar utha na saka wamusibata
Sar peet-te hain saare namazi ye karke bain
Masjid mein Qatl-e-Nafs-e-Khuda Wamusibata
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab pachhade khaati hain Hasnain rote hain
Khadmao mein koi ghash mein pada Wamusibata
Zainab tadapke kehti hai veera’n huwa ye ghar
Baba pe kisne zulm kiya Wamusibata
<<DIVIDER>>
Hyder ke gird Maadar-e-Abbas ke the bain
Waali ki mere radd ho bala Wamusibata
Bewo’n ki aur yateemo’n ki ab kaun le khabar
Mushkil kusha ne ki hai qaza Wamusibata
<<DIVIDER>>
Aulad-e-Murtuza ne amaame diye utaar
Saidaniyo ne sar se rida wamusibata
Qasim ye shor-o-shain hai Aal-e-Nabi mein aaj
Baba ka sar se saaya utha Wamusibata
